title: EcosystemWeb
description: A curated ecosystem food web: 1-25 nodes with trophic links, full provenance, and layout hints in a normalized 0-100 coordinate space. Canonical documentation: docs/data-format.md.

meta.description: Provenance and identification metadata for the web.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier; the file in data/webs/ must be named <id>.json.

location.description: Human-readable location (e.g. 'Prince William Sound, Alaska, USA').

lat.description: Latitude of a representative point, for a future map view.

lng.description: Longitude of a representative point, for a future map view.

provenance.description: 'empirical' = one published study measured this web; 'composite' = curated from multiple sources.

tagline.description: One-line hook shown on browse cards (e.g. 'Home to one of the best-studied keystone cascades').

citations.description: Full citations for every source used. At least one is required.

sourceUrl.description: URL of the primary source (paper, dataset, or data portal).

licenseNote.description: License/attribution note for the underlying data.

curator.description: Name or handle of the person who curated this web.

dateCurated.description: Date the web was curated, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD).

nodes.description: The nodes of the web. Curated, not comprehensive: hard ceiling of 25 nodes.

edges.description: Trophic links: prey -> predator ('prey is eaten by predator').

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier, unique within the web.

displayName.description: Plain-language name shown in the UI.

kind.description: Granularity of the node, exactly as the source measured it. When not 'species', the description MUST state the aggregation (see docs/data-format.md).

trophicLevel.description: Trophic level; fractional values allowed (e.g. 2.4). Producers/detritus are level 1.

description.description: Plain-language description. For kind != 'species' it must include an aggregation statement (which species/groups are pooled, and why).

externalLinks.description: Optional reference links for curious readers.

metrics.description: Optional quantitative research metrics from the source study, kept clearly separate from the core web structure. Never fabricate; omit when the source does not report them.

biomass.description: Standing biomass in the units reported by the source (state units in the description).

respiration.description: Respiration flow in the units reported by the source.

import.description: Import into the system in the units reported by the source.

export.description: Export out of the system in the units reported by the source.

layout.description: Layout hint in a normalized 0-100 coordinate space: x 0 = left, y 0 = bottom. Seeded from trophic level; the renderer may refine x but must respect trophic ordering.

edge.description: A trophic link from prey to predator. It carries EITHER a quantitative diet-share 'weight' (0-1) OR 'qualitative': true when the source lacks flow data - never both, never neither, and never a fabricated weight.

prey.description: id of the node being eaten.

predator.description: id of the node that eats the prey.

weight.description: Share of the predator's diet contributed by this prey, 0-1, taken directly from the source.

qualitative.description: Marks an edge whose existence is documented but whose strength is not quantified by the source.
